identity.name: Coinbase International Exchange NVIDIA Corp. Perp

about.description: NVDA is a single-stock perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking NVIDIA Corp., margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 10× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
